- [author] theme — Q: Should the stadium read as a modern broadcast arena, or something more stylised? A: Use a modern broadcast-style soccer arena, matching the realistic match, VAR, replay, and team-kit setup.
- [author] scale — Q: How big is big - a club ground or a full national stadium bowl? A: Make it a full national stadium bowl so it feels like a big professional soccer match venue.

## Enriched image prompt
Create a large modern broadcast-style national soccer stadium centered on one standard full pitch. Use a clearly marked grass field with touchlines, goal lines, halfway line, center circle, penalty areas, penalty spots, corner arcs, and two goals at opposite ends. Surround the pitch with safe sideline run-off space, blue and red team technical areas with substitute benches, and a full tiered stadium bowl oriented toward the field. Keep sightlines open from every stand and make the complete pitch, both goals, benches, and professional arena enclosure readable from an elevated view. Do not add unrelated training fields or extra match spaces.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Sports, canonical slug `sports`.

## Shape and preset
Use `space-bounded`, the Bounded Field or Court shape, for one rigid soccer pitch perimeter. The matched preset is Full Stadium, retaining its tiered bowl, arena enclosure, and team-side spectator or substitute sectors, with standard field-sport boundaries and scoring footprints added.

## Config requirements
Use `trigger-bounds` for the visible touchlines and goal lines, `startpoint-play` for the center spot and fixed restart marks, `trigger-scoring` for the two goal mouths, `spectator-bleachers` for the national stadium bowl, `barrier-perimeter` for the outer arena enclosure, and `spectator-zone` for blue and red technical areas and substitute benches.

## Layout requirements
Place one `trigger-bounds` TriggerZone exactly on the pitch perimeter. Place `startpoint-play` StartPoints at the center spot and two penalty spots, aligned to the painted markings. Place exactly two `trigger-scoring` TriggerZones, one through each goal mouth. Player roles, bots, cards, substitutions, replay, controls, animations, and ball behavior are mechanics rather than fixed layout placements.

## Layout components
The build contains one full marked soccer pitch, two goals, two color-coded technical areas, clear run-off space, a continuous tiered national-stadium bowl, and an outer enclosure. The field remains the central unobstructed focal plane, with all audience sightlines directed inward.

## Render order
Use `topdown`; standard pitch proportions, mirrored goals, markings, and scoring volumes must be authoritative before stadium dressing.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is large because a full professional pitch and national stadium bowl must fit while field markings remain legible. The theme is a realistic modern broadcast soccer arena. Use `tiered` for the rising bowl seating without overhangs; no other modifier is forced.
